<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ========== 常量与状态 ========== */
  var STORAGE_KEY = "todo-list-items";
  var currentFilter = "all"; // all | active | done

  // 从 localStorage 读取数据；解析失败时回退为空数组
  function loadTodos() {
    try {
      var raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      var data = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      return Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
    } catch (e) {
      return [];
    }
  }

  var todos = loadTodos();

  /* ========== DOM 引用 ========== */
  var form = document.getElementById("add-form");
  var input = document.getElementById("todo-input");
  var list = document.getElementById("todo-list");
  var emptyState = document.getElementById("empty-state");
  var emptyText = document.getElementById("empty-text");
  var totalCount = document.getElementById("total-count");
  var doneCount = document.getElementById("done-count");
  var clearDoneBtn = document.getElementById("clear-done");
  var filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".filter-btn");
  var todayLabel = document.getElementById("today-label");

  /* ========== 工具函数 ========== */
  // 持久化：保存到 localStorage
  function save() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(todos));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("保存失败：", e);
    }
  }

  // 生成唯一 id（时间戳 + 随机数，够用即可）
  function genId() {
    return Date.now().toString(36) + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
  }

  // 格式化时间：MM-DD HH:mm
  function formatTime(ts) {
    var d = new Date(ts);
    function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : "" + n; }
    return pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getDate()) + " " +
           pad(d.getHours()) + ":" + pad(d.getMinutes());
  }

  // 根据当前筛选条件判断某条待办是否显示
  function matchesFilter(todo) {
    if (currentFilter === "active") return !todo.done;
    if (currentFilter === "done") return todo.done;
    return true;
  }

  /* ========== 渲染 ========== */
  function render() {
    list.innerHTML = "";

    var visible = todos.filter(matchesFilter);

    if (visible.length === 0) {
      emptyState.hidden = false;
      if (todos.length === 0) {
        emptyText.textContent = "还没有待办，添加一个吧！";
      } else if (currentFilter === "active") {
        emptyText.textContent = "太棒了，没有进行中的任务 🎉";
      } else if (currentFilter === "done") {
        emptyText.textContent = "还没有已完成的任务";
      } else {
        emptyText.textContent = "列表空空的…";
      }
    } else {
      emptyState.hidden = true;
    }

    visible.forEach(function (todo) {
      var li = document.createElement("li");
      li.className = "todo-item" + (todo.done ? " done" : "");
      li.dataset.id = todo.id;

      // 勾选框
      var check = document.createElement("input");
      check.type = "checkbox";
      check.className = "todo-check";
      check.checked = todo.done;
      check.title = todo.done ? "标记为未完成" : "标记为完成";
      check.addEventListener("change", function () {
        toggleTodo(todo.id, check.checked);
      });

      // 文本
      var span = document.createElement("span");
      span.className = "todo-text";
      span.textContent = todo.text;

      // 时间
      var time = document.createElement("span");
      time.className = "todo-time";
      time.textContent = formatTime(todo.createdAt);

      // 删除按钮
      var del = document.createElement("button");
      del.className = "delete-btn";
      del.textContent = "✕";
      del.title = "删除";
      del.addEventListener("click", function () {
        deleteTodo(todo.id);
      });

      li.appendChild(check);
      li.appendChild(span);
      li.appendChild(time);
      li.appendChild(del);
      list.appendChild(li);
    });

    // 统计
    totalCount.textContent = todos.length;
    doneCount.textContent = todos.filter(function (t) { return t.done; }).length;
  }
